title: Newgrange curbstone with perplexing symbols

tellings.quote: within New Graange, there is a curb stone outside of New Graange that's inscribed with all of these perplexing symbols.

plain: Outside Newgrange, an ancient monument in Ireland, there is a curbstone "inscribed with all of these perplexing symbols". A guest named Geoffrey Drumm describes it to Michels without naming a source, treating the carvings as a puzzle about what the ancient builders knew.
